description: Get Duplicate Contact. Get Duplicate Contact.<br/><br/>If `Allow Duplicate Contact` is disabled under Settings, the global unique identifier will be used for searching the contact. If the setting is enabled, first priority for search is `email` and the second priority will be `phone`.
